meta.name: cimbra-constructora-landing
meta.description: Design DNA extracted directly from the Cimbra Constructora landing page source (React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Motion) — not from an external image or URL reference. Ground-truth values were read from the project's own design tokens and components, which is more precise than pixel measurement. An industrial-premium, dark-graphite marketing site for a construction company with a single amber accent and a blueprint/structural-engineering visual metaphor.
source_references: E:/Proyectos-front/constructora-front-web/src/features/* (hero, navigation, trust-metrics, services, projects, process, testimonials, contact-cta, footer)

accent.role: single signal accent — CTAs, links, data emphasis, hero/CTA glow (construction-safety amber, desaturated ~75%)

neutral.usage: paper tones (#F3F4F2, #E7E8E5) for primary headline/body text on dark surfaces; concrete tones (#B7BBC0, #9BA0A6) for secondary/muted text, captions and card labels; graphite tones (#383D41 down to #0E1011) for backgrounds, borders and elevation from lightest surface to deepest background

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast, dark-dominant: near-white paper text (#F3F4F2) on graphite backgrounds (#121415), with the single warm amber accent reserved strictly for CTAs and data emphasis so it never competes with the neutral scale. Semantic colors (success/warning/error/info) are not implemented in the source (no forms or status UI exist) and are inferred here to sit tonally with the existing palette.

caption.tracking: normal (defined for completeness; not used in a live component — this design avoids micro-caption labels by choice)

overline.tracking: 0.08em (defined for completeness; deliberately unused — eyebrow/all-caps labels were avoided as a genre-default tell)

font_families.heading: Space Grotesk (geometric/technical grotesk, self-hosted via @fontsource)
font_families.body: IBM Plex Sans (humanist sans originally built for technical documentation, self-hosted via @fontsource)
font_families.mono: not used — no monospace typography anywhere in this design

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric technical display face paired with a documentation-grade humanist body face, chosen to evoke blueprint precision and structural engineering rather than software/SaaS neutrality. Scale is manual rather than a strict ratio, with a deliberately large jump from heading_1 to display to give the hero a single dominant moment.

spacing.scale: Tailwind default rem scale; UI leans on large multiples (gap-4/6/8/10/14, section padding py-20 to py-28) rather than tight increments
spacing.content_density: spacious — generous section padding and card padding, closer to 'art gallery' than 'daily app' density
spacing.section_rhythm: consistent large vertical rhythm of py-20 to py-28 between major sections; only the trust-metrics strip directly under the hero uses the tighter py-20

layout.grid_system: CSS Grid throughout: 12-column for the asymmetric hero split, an explicit dense auto-flow 4-col x 2-row bento for services, 4-col for the process flow, 3-col for testimonials, and a flex overflow-x scroll-snap track for the projects gallery
layout.gutter: 1rem to 2rem (gap-4 to gap-8) depending on section
layout.breakpoints: Tailwind defaults — sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536. Two-column/asymmetric compositions activate at lg; md collapses bento/testimonials to 2 columns; below md everything is a single stacked column
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric — left-aligned headlines and an asymmetric hero split/bento grid by default, with exactly one deliberate exception: the closing CTA banner is centered as the page's single climactic moment

border_radius.large: 2rem (32px) — outer double-bezel shells, hero image frame, bento tiles, CTA banner
border_radius.pill: 9999px (rounded-full) — every button and the floating nav island

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairline borders (white/10) on almost every card and container edge, functioning as the outer shell of a double-bezel nested-container system
shape.divider_style: 1px hairline borders at 5-10% white opacity between sections, inside the footer, and inside testimonial-card footers; no heavy rules or dense divide-y lists

elevation.shadow_style: soft, mostly inset — no hard external drop shadows anywhere on the page

levels.low: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06) — inner top highlight inside card cores (stat tiles, testimonials)
levels.medium: outer shell of border + bg-white/[0.03] wrapping a slightly lighter inner core (the double-bezel pattern) on stat tiles, testimonial cards and the hero image frame
levels.high: not used — the design intentionally has no strongly elevated/floating shadow layer

elevation.depth_cues: nested double-bezel layers (outer shell + inner core), backdrop-blur on the floating nav and mobile menu, static radial gradient glows behind the hero and CTA, and dark gradient scrims over photography rather than drop shadows

iconography.size_scale: 14-18px inline with text; 16-18px centered inside 32-40px circular chips
iconography.preferred_set: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) exclusively — no hand-rolled SVG icon paths

motion.easing: custom fluid cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for nearly all transitions and reveals, plus a spring (stiffness ~200, damping ~18, mass 0.4) for the magnetic CTA hover

duration_scale.normal: 600-700ms — scroll-triggered fade-up reveals on cards and sections
duration_scale.macro: 900ms-1.4s — hero image entrance and the animated metric count-up

motion.entrance_pattern: fade + 24-28px upward translate, staggered ~0.09-0.12s per sibling, triggered once when a section enters the viewport (whileInView, 30% visibility threshold)
motion.exit_pattern: simple opacity fade only (mobile menu overlay close); the page has no route transitions or dedicated exit choreography elsewhere
motion.philosophy: restrained, motivated motion — one orchestrated hero entrance, per-section scroll reveals for hierarchy, physics-based feedback limited to the primary CTA and the metric counters. Every animation collapses to a static state under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.button_style: fully rounded pill buttons; primary = solid amber fill with dark text and a nested circular icon chip ('button-in-button'), ghost = 1px white/15 border pill with a translucent icon chip; both use pointer-follow magnetic physics and a tap scale-down
components.input_style: not implemented — no forms exist on this landing page; contact happens via mailto:/tel: links
components.card_style: double-bezel nested cards: an outer shell (hairline border + faint white wash + large radius) wraps an inner core (elevated graphite background + inset top highlight + a proportionally smaller radius)
components.navigation_pattern: a floating pill 'island' nav detached from the viewport top with backdrop-blur; below lg it collapses into a full-screen, near-opaque, staggered-reveal overlay behind a hamburger icon that morphs into an X
components.modal_style: not implemented — the only overlay in the UI is the full-screen mobile navigation panel
components.list_style: no bulleted or divide-y lists anywhere; every dataset (services, projects, process, testimonials, metrics) is rendered as its own bespoke bento grid, scroll-snap gallery, connected-numeral flow, or card grid instead
components.component_notes: no data tables, no forms, no modals. Content density is kept low per section (headline + short body + one visual) rather than dumping long lists into generic rows

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: architectural blueprint and reinforced concrete — precision engineering translated into a dark, structural interface
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary tech-editorial with a nod to technical/blueprint drafting conventions, rather than any specific historical design era
aesthetic.genre: industrial-premium service marketing for construction/engineering — closer to a boutique architecture studio site than a generic SaaS landing page

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents only — icon chips, radial glows, and double-bezel edges; no decorative patterns or textures
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous, gallery-leaning (py-24 to py-28 section padding) without going to a minimal-manifesto extreme
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: left-weighted in split sections (hero) with one centered exception (the closing CTA banner)
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal — one clear focal element per section (hero image, featured bento tile, single CTA) rather than several competing elements
visual_language.contrast_level: high — near-white text on near-black graphite, one saturated accent color
visual_language.texture_usage: none — flat graphite fields; the only texture comes from photography and soft gradient glows

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast plus color weight — large display type for headlines, amber reserved strictly for emphasis and action
composition.balance_type: asymmetric, with a single deliberate symmetric/centered exception at the closing CTA
composition.flow_direction: vertical scroll narrative: hero (promise) -> proof (metrics) -> capability (services) -> evidence (projects) -> trust (process, testimonials) -> action (CTA)
composition.grouping_strategy: nested double-bezel containers for card grouping; a connected-numeral flow (hairline + node circles) for the sequential process section
composition.negative_space_role: structural — whitespace paces the scroll narrative and separates sections rather than serving as decoration

imagery.photo_treatment: full-bleed photography with a bottom-to-top dark gradient scrim for text legibility; no color grading, duotone or filter applied
imagery.illustration_style: none — no hand-drawn or decorative illustration; only Phosphor line icons
imagery.graphic_elements: static soft radial amber glow behind the hero headline and the CTA banner; thin numeral node circles and a connecting hairline in the process flow
imagery.image_shape: large rounded rectangles (2rem radius) inset in a double-bezel frame; portrait 4:5 aspect ratio for the hero and project images

interaction_feel.feedback_style: physical/tactile — magnetic pointer-follow on the primary CTA, scale-down on tap, diagonal icon nudge on button hover
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: card images scale up (1.05) beneath their gradient scrim; button icon chips translate diagonally; nav links brighten from concrete grey to paper white
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth glide with a touch of spring — fluid cubic-bezier for reveals, spring physics for the magnetic button
interaction_feel.loading_style: not implemented — fully static content, no async data fetching or skeleton states
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low-to-moderate — deliberately rationed to the CTA, nav and stat counters rather than applied to every element

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: direct and confident, plain-language Mexican Spanish, no marketing filler verbs
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: professional but approachable — informal 'tú' address to the visitor, precise/technical language when describing services
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative ('Cotiza tu proyecto'), reused verbatim across nav, hero and the closing CTA so the same action always carries the same label
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: not applicable — static marketing page with no dynamic or empty states
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: not applicable — no forms or user input exist on this page

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to static — every animated element checks useReducedMotion() (Motion) and collapses instantly to its resting state under prefers-reduced-motion

background_effects.description: a soft, fixed (non-animated) amber radial gradient sits behind the hero headline and again behind the closing CTA banner, quietly reinforcing the single accent color at the two highest-intent moments on the page

params.density: one soft blob per section (hero, CTA)

particle_systems.description: not used anywhere in this design

3d_elements.description: not used — no Three.js, WebGL or 3D asset in the page

shader_effects.description: not used — no custom GLSL/shader work in the page

parallax.depth_range: 0 to 90px vertical translate across the hero's own scroll span
parallax.speed_curve: linear mapping of scrollYProgress (0 to 1, tracked only across the hero section) to a 0-90px translateY via Motion's useScroll/useTransform — contained entirely within the hero, not a page-wide parallax system

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: whileInView on every major section (trust-metrics, services, projects, process, testimonials, CTA) at a 30% visibility threshold, firing once
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: fade-up with staggered children, plus a one-time numeric counter animation on the trust-metrics tiles
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: none — each reveal plays forward once on entry rather than scrubbing with scroll position (only the hero parallax is scroll-position-bound)

scroll_morphing.description: not used — no section-to-section shape or color morphing tied to scroll position

text_effects.description: headline and body copy always animate as whole blocks (fade-up); no per-character/per-word/per-line text animation is used anywhere

params.stagger: staggering exists between sibling elements (headline, subtext, CTAs), not within a single text string

cursor_effects.description: primary and secondary CTA buttons translate a few pixels toward the pointer within a bounded radius (strength factor 0.35 of pointer offset from center), spring-eased back to center on pointer leave; there is no custom cursor replacement or trail

params.shape: n/a — native OS cursor is unchanged
params.interaction_zone: the bounding box of each Button component

image_effects.description: service and project images scale up 5% on card hover beneath a fixed dark gradient scrim; the hero image additionally carries a scroll-bound vertical parallax shift (see scroll_effects.parallax)
image_effects.technology: CSS transform via Tailwind group-hover for the zoom; one Motion-driven scroll transform for the hero's parallax

params.filter_pipeline: none — no blur, grayscale or duotone filters applied to any image
params.reveal_animation: opacity/scale entrance on first viewport intersection (whileInView for cards; initial scale 0.96 to 1 for the hero image)

params.blur_radius: backdrop-blur-xl (~24px) on the desktop floating nav pill; backdrop-blur-2xl (~40px) on the full-screen mobile menu overlay
params.transparency: nav pill background at ~70% opacity; mobile overlay at ~97% opacity (intentionally near-opaque for legibility over large type)
params.border_treatment: 1px hairline border at ~10% white opacity around the nav pill
params.shadow_type: none — the blur and border alone communicate the glass surface, no drop shadow
params.light_source_angle: n/a — no directional highlight or gradient sheen is applied

canvas_drawings.description: not used — no <canvas> element anywhere in the page

svg_animations.description: no <svg> path animation is used. The hamburger-to-X 'morph' in the nav is implemented with two rotating/translating <span> elements animated via CSS transform (Motion), not SVG path morphing

params.animation_method: n/a (CSS transform on div/span elements, not SVG)

visual_effects.composite_notes: Effects are deliberately rationed: one orchestrated hero entrance, per-section scroll-triggered reveals, a magnetic primary CTA, an animated metric counter, and glass-blur limited strictly to fixed/sticky nav surfaces (never applied to scrolling content, to avoid the continuous-repaint performance cost). There is no WebGL, Canvas, shader or particle work anywhere in the page — the visual richness instead comes from layout variety (asymmetric hero, dense bento grid, horizontal scroll-snap gallery), the double-bezel nested-card system, and full-bleed photography. Every motion primitive reduces cleanly to a static state under prefers-reduced-motion, and no effect is applied to a blurred or backdrop-filtered element that also scrolls.
